verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at pipedream.com/llms.txt and agent-readable markdown docs (e.g. /docs/connect/mcp.md) that point agents to a full documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. Per-app markdown pages such as clickup.md and openai.md give agents structured endpoint, header and tool details. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and first-party prose explaining the llms.txt/markdown docs program.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
